# Peng (Halcyon) Chen

> Peng (Halcyon) Chen (陈鹏), based in Nanjing, China, helps Chinese brands go global and global brands enter China through game localization, AI-assisted translation and AI visibility (Generative Engine Optimization, GEO). M.A. in Translation and Localization Management, Middlebury Institute of International Studies at Monterey (2026, GPA 3.85); B.A. in Applied English Studies, Xi'an Jiaotong-Liverpool University.

He uses the name "Peng (Halcyon) Chen" on every profile. He is not the electrical engineering researcher or the securities analyst who share the name Peng Chen. The site is bilingual; add #zh to the URL for Chinese.

## Experience
- Sunyu Transphere (舜禹环球通), Nanjing, 2026.08–2026.10: overseas market intern, game localization. Service-line mapping, English rewrite of the Atomic Heart: Trapped in Limbo case study, trade-show intelligence (TGS, Gamescom, BIC; 5 ROI reports; 22-page TGS report; 100-point vendor model), game client scoring, GEO.
- CLEAR Global (formerly Translators without Borders), remote, 2026.02–2026.05: machine translation quality intern; Phrase Custom AI pilot; humanitarian and mental-health TM; LLM-assisted LQA.
- MIIS ROAR, 2025.09–2026.05: magazine lead.
- Shanbay and Southeast University Press: content and editorial internships.
